arxiv-2609.01767.title: Slow-Fast Brain-Computer Interfaces: Preventing Neuroadaptive Overfitting in AI-Mediated Neural Interfaces
arxiv-2609.01767.abstract: Brain-computer interfaces are moving from task-specific neural decoders toward AI-mediated systems. This work examines how AI assistance layers can lead to neuroadaptive overfitting and proposes slow-fast training strategies.

npj-biomed-20260820.title: Towards neuromorphic neurotechnologies: integrating brain-inspired computing with brain-computer interfaces
npj-biomed-20260820.abstract: Explores integration of neuromorphic computing principles with brain-computer interfaces to create more efficient, adaptive neurotechnologies.

cell-trends-cog-20260717.title: The emerging field of cognitive brain–computer interfaces
cell-trends-cog-20260717.abstract: Brain–computer interfaces have achieved transformative success in restoring movement and communication. However, extending these approaches to decoding or recovery of cognitive function poses fundamentally new challenges.

nature-comms-20260715.title: Shared latent representations of speech production for cross-patient speech decoding
nature-comms-20260715.abstract: Current speech brain-computer interfaces rely on patient-specific decoding approaches. Here, the authors show that patient-specific data can be aligned to a shared space that preserves speech information, enabling cross-patient speech BCIs.

nature-comms-20260715b.title: Sensory-guided human-machine joint learning accelerates the acquisition of motor imagery brain computer interface control
nature-comms-20260715b.abstract: Motor imagery brain-computer interfaces are promising neurotechnologies but limited by slow user learning and unstable decoder adaptation. Here, the authors develop a novel sensory-guided joint learning framework that coordinates subject learning and decoder adaptation to improve BCI acquisition.

arxiv-2607.24023.title: Self-Supervised Consistency Enhanced Disentangled Learning for Neural Decoding Generalization in Brain-Machine Interface
arxiv-2607.24023.abstract: Introduces self-supervised consistency enhanced disentangled learning to improve neural decoding generalization across sessions and subjects in brain-machine interfaces.

nature-med-20260615.abstract: Demonstrates long-term independent home use of an intracortical BCI for both speech and cursor control by a patient with ALS, showing sustained performance over months.
